items.title: John Beal interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2024
items.q: many years later I got to play on her record that she wrote, you know, in the string section of a record called “Baltimore.”

ctx.x: Yeah. I’m going to run a few names by you and see if you have any recollections or comments about them. I’m going to start with Nina Simone?

Nina Simone, my comment is that I was with Woody’s band in Atlantic City playing at the Steel Pier and we had a night off, and I went into a bar and there was this woman playing and singing and it sounded great. And I asked the bartender, “Who is that?” He said, “Nina Simone but her real name is Eunice Brown.” And I went up there to speak with her and I said, “Eunice” and she said, “Who told you that?” And she was using Nina.
